top_signals.title: Meta Settlement a ‘Pittance,’ Law Professor Says
top_signals.summary: Meta’s settlement is a “pittance” relative to the company’s profits, according to University of Virginia Law Professor Danielle Citron. She argues the bigger question is whether new protections for teenage Facebook and Instagram users will actually work, questioning a framework that relies heavily on parents to enforce limits and warning that teenagers may find ways around the restrictions. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary:

top_signals.title: De Olho nas Eleições
top_signals.summary:
A repórter Beatriz Reis conta o que Lula e Congresso acertaram para um esforço concentrado de votações no Legislativo antes das eleições. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)
